name: Studio
description: Studio's thread list by project with status chips and a Settled shelf, its start page with one button per agent and every account's usage, a thread details card in Session Info, and a work-log hover card.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list threads by project with their status.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its thread; read the hovered workspace's facts.
scopes.usage_app:read: Read the usage left on your Claude and Codex accounts from cmux's Usage app.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a thread's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a thread with the agent you pick, or open a thread in a tab.
